newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - British Airways on path to 650p.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - British Airways on path to 650p.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-20 * MA-50
+ British Airways shares should reach 650p over the medium-term, technical analysts said.

+ This follows recent chart breakout from 610p and a golden-cross from the stock's 20 and 50 day moving averages. Stock market dullness will prevent the shares from marching up too rapidly above 635p which was a target calculated from a symmetrical triangle pattern also completed in February.
Recent chart breakout by British Airways paves the way for the shares to advance a little higher over the medium-term, technical analysts said.
"The price has broken above important resistance at 610p opening the way for an advance to the 640p-650p range," said Richard Marshall, a director at Investment Research of Cambridge Ltd.

Medium-term moving averages confirm the positive view on the stock, he added. "But on a longer-term basis the shares are also a chart buy with a strong uptrend on both price and relative strength ratio showing no signs of faltering."
By 0900 GMT, British Airways shares were up 6p to 636-1/2p.

Prior to the breakout from 610p, the shares had completed a symmetrical triangle pattern between December to mid-February. The pattern consists of a pair of converging trendlines connecting the major peaks and troughs of the share price since mid-December.
The maximum height of this pattern -- of 35p -- when added to the breakout at about 600p from the triangle gives a target of 635p.
This target was first reached on February 20 and some consolidation is likely before the shares can move too high.

British Airways price-relative chart -- of the share price divided by the All-Share index -- spiked up around mid-February and is close to breaking out but any market weakness may rub off onto the shares delaying the likelihood of breakout on the price-relative.
